== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The [[Titan]] Knights, also known as the [[Knights of the Titan Force]], were a group of galactic defenders tasked with protecting the universe from various monsters. Their most significant achievement was successfully repelling the [[D’Niss Swarm]], an insectoid threat led by a queen capable of consuming stars. While official records suggest the organization retired after completing their mission, different timelines indicate varying fates for the group, including a tragic end in some instances. During their peak popularity, the Knights were well-known figures who benefited from high levels of public visibility and media promotion. Each Knight pilots a [[Divine Titan]], which are highly advanced [[Aethertech]] machines that possess their own unique personalities and levels of consciousness. These [[Titans]] serve as powerful weapons, though they can be dangerous if a pilot is overwhelmed or if the machine becomes infected. The Knights are identified by specific colors, such as [[Red]], Blue, Green, and Yellow. Notable members include [[Raion Raithe]], who served as the [[Red]] Knight and Captain of the group, a former [[Blue Knight]], and [[Serrian]], a biologist who served as the [[Yellow Knight]]. The role of a Knight requires immense selflessness and is often associated with specialized combat abilities and ship security responsibilities.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Formed specifically to combat the [[D’Niss]], the [[Titan]] Knights are a group of five individuals that includes [[Raion Raithe|Raion]]. Serving as guardians of the galaxy, these once extremely popular warriors utilize a training room filled with mechanical enemies to hone their skills. While [[Varic Vallenar]] was eventually welcomed into the group, the knights have fared worse in this current life than they did in the narrator's memory. Despite the narrator not joining them in a previous life, [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] has addressed the group as a new generation of [[Titan]] Knights prepares to emerge.}}
